activities.title: JSON-Python Explorer
activities.instruction: Identify the Python type corresponding to each JSON value.

content.concept: Python's json module maps JSON objects to dictionaries, arrays to lists, strings to str, numbers to int or float, booleans to bool, and null to None.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: JSON object is represented as a Python dictionary.
JSON array is represented as a Python list.
JSON string is represented as a Python string.
JSON true/false values map to Python True/False.
JSON null maps to Python None.
